pages.text: Ordinary elemental spell damage starts from 5% resistance. Chaos starts from 1%, then randomly resolves to one of the Five Elements. A specific mastery adds 20% against its own element and 5% against each other Five Element; Omni adds 10% against every Five Element, and None adds 0%. Effective resistance also includes the resolved acquired bonus and Spell Resist, then subtracts the caster's resistance ignore once.

At effective resistance >= 5%, damage multiplier is max(0.10, (1 - resistance) / 0.95). At 5% this is 1.0. Below 5%, vulnerability rises linearly: multiplier = 1 + clamp((0.05 - resistance) / 0.04, 0, 1), up to 2x damage.

$(bold)Tribulation example$(): an ordinary strike uses 5% plus the matching element bonus. A chaos strike uses 1% plus the bonus of its displayed five-element strike; because chaos itself cannot store a bonus, prepare broad five-element resistance rather than looking for a Chaos resistance stat.$(br2)$(bold)Warning:$() Realm suppression and elemental resistance are separate multipliers.
